2. Check if any of these speakers have co-authors who became Fellows of the American Mathematical Society in 2002.
3. Look for co-authors who completed their PhD at the University of Toronto between 1995 and 2005.
4. Search for research papers published between 2001 and 2009 that end with the word "problems" and have exactly three authors.

This structured approach will help narrow down the search for the specific research paper.
